trace_scope: Entire peer lifecycle, including handshake, ciphertext, shutdown, QUIC ACK/retry/control packets. Attempts include errors, would-block and unreturned calls at termination; unreturned calls are counted separately. Batched UDP returns datagrams, not bytes. No Capn Proto message count inference.

profile_limitations.reason: Instrumented frozen baseline disconnected during the trial; no valid results. All eight-service profiles excluded from before/after comparisons. Native benchmarks keep the eight-service workload.
